definitionZh: CSS对齐内容属性将内容项目之间和周围的空间分布设置在一个弹性框的交叉轴上,或者一个网格或块级元素的块轴上.
sourceDefinition: The CSS align-content property sets the distribution of space between and around content items along a flexbox's cross axis, or a grid or block-level element's block axis.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The CSS align-content property sets the distribution of space between and around content items along a flexbox's cross axis, or a grid or block-level element's block axis.
